properties.name: The reasons behind an existing system are recorded from the person who designed it
properties.source: Anthony Sligar, 2026-09-23, after a field user said the code is not the important part: the decisions behind it are
properties.statement: When a system already exists and the person who designed it is available, reflow2 can record WHY it is the way it is — who needed each feature and why each change was made — from that person, with the version history setting the questions and every answer theirs, and without requiring a model of the code's structure.
